title: Barcelona’s new signings raise the stakes in battle for left-wing starting spot
tweet: Both Gordon and Adeyemi netted in the 4‑1 win over Galatasaray, showing that the left‑wing battle is more heated than ever. As things stand, Flick has a viable backup that can deliver goals from the bench, giving him flexibility in a congested fixture list. The real test will be who earns the start consistently.
